descriptor_policy.spatial_location: Frozen final stage output immediately before global average pooling: ResNet layer4 NCHW2048x8x8, ConvNeXt features[7] NCHW768x8x8.
descriptor_policy.mean: Existing official pooled embedding retained exactly: ResNet average; ConvNeXt average then pretrained terminal LayerNorm. Same mean columns in both arms.
descriptor_policy.std: Population spatial channel std (correction=0) on the SAME pre-pool final-stage map, before terminal ConvNeXt pooled LayerNorm; append raw std. Do not apply LayerNorm to std or move LayerNorm before pooling.
descriptor_policy.interpretation: Test adding marginal spatial dispersion to the existing mean descriptor, conditional on a train-only PCA128 bottleneck. Not a pure comparison of two unchanged raw descriptors; PCA axes and variance retained differ.

preprocess.raw_scale: Each mean/std bank independently: train mean, population std; scale=max(std_j, sqrt(mean_j(var_j))). All-zero bank uses unit scales. Mean bank scales identical across arms. No validation fitting.
preprocess.PCA: sklearn PCA(n_components=128,svd_solver=full,whiten=False), float64, fitted only on 320 outer-train rows. Transform by stored mean/components for both train and validation; no fit_transform mismatch.
preprocess.post_PCA_scale: Same train-only RMS-floor scaling before MLP; target train mean/std.

protocol.head: Linear128->64, GELU, Dropout.25, Linear64->1; CPU2threads; 100epochs, batch64, AdamWlr3e-4 WD.01, cosine to1e-5, SmoothL1beta1 standardizedtarget, globalclip1; seed202710185+fold. Same initial weights and sample/dropout seed botharms and models; 500updates each. Fixed final epoch.
protocol.evaluation: Original400/5 groupfolds; standalone and fixed.9best021+.1arm. Same185 gate gain>=.02, >=3positivefold, bootstrapCI_lower>0, remove_top5gain>0. Mean_std also must beat paired mean control overall standalone and blend with >=3fold blend gains. No resplit until parent reviews passing evidence.

limits: Existing scratch TinyCNN already uses mean/std; novelty is this frozen pretrained descriptor and matched PCA/head control.

Mean descriptor preserved exactly from188/190; each arm has a different train-only PCA subspace. The experiment estimates the full pooling-plus-compression pipeline, not an isolated std effect under fixed PCA axes.
PCA128 can discard signal. Failed comparison does not prove all spatial variability is useless or backbone capacity is exhausted.
Spatial std is a marginal dispersion statistic, not spatial arrangement or physical grain segmentation.
Reused development400 and conditional bootstrap are not independent validation or selection-adjusted evidence.
